neighbours.label: The piece starting the second element of a compound name (Strom-b-oli, Strom-berg, Stein-b-renner, Stone-h-enge); plain short names in the same frames stay quiet
fire: The island of Stromboli lies north of Sicily.
An old Stromberg radio sat on the desk.
Owner Steinbrenner fired the coach again.
Young Steinbrenner hired her uncle in June.
Druids still gather at Stonehenge at dawn.
The Steinberg family moved to Ohio.
